task: ae.minisql mini SQL database: lexer, sealed-AST recursive-descent parser, 3VL evaluator, joins, grouping, ordering, atomic statements and transactions, seeded differential oracle tests
reasoning_summary: Designed the grammar and semantics in TASK.md first, wrote per-feature literal-expectation tests plus a seeded differential suite with an independent three-valued-logic oracle, then implemented lexer, parser, evaluator and executor. Statements are atomic by validating a replacement row list before swapping it in, which also makes BEGIN snapshots cheap. Three mutants (IN/NULL handling, null ordering, LEFT JOIN null extension) were each caught by the tests.
